title: Measures at Checkpoints to Deter Wildlife Trafficking
what_it_is: Measures at Checkpoints to Deter Wildlife Trafficking

sections.label: Border risk assessment and checks
sections.summary: All passengers, cargoes and shipments undergo risk assessment, and agencies carry out multiple layers of checks at Singapore's border checkpoints.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: First, we subject all passengers and cargoes as well as shipments to risk assessment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Our risk assessment framework helps agencies flag out which passengers and shipments require more detailed checks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Second, agencies carry out multiple layers of checks at Singapore's border checkpoints.

sections.label: Illegal wildlife seizures and penalties
sections.summary: These measures led to seizures of illegal wildlife, traffickers face fines up to $500,000 or two years' imprisonment, and Singapore uses scanning technologies instead of sniffer dogs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Taken together, these measures have led to several successful seizures of illegal wildlife in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Traffickers face heavy penalties like fines of up to $500,000, or imprisonment of up to two years, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To the Member's specific question about sniffer dogs, we understand that they are used in some countries to detect wildlife products.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In Singapore, we use other effective scanning technologies for this purpose.

sections.label: Intelligence, technology and sniffer dogs
sections.summary: It starts with good intelligence and proven technology, and sniffer dogs will be considered if objective data shows they are more effective than current methods.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: It starts with good intelligence and then employing technology and techniques that have been proven to work in many other cases.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, we will continue to look at options, including sniffer dogs, if there can be objective data to show that they are more effective than our currently deployed methods.
